name: charge-retry
title: Retry a charge when the payment gateway times out

task.title: Retry a charge when the payment gateway times out
task.html: Checkout fails an order when the payment gateway times out, even when a second attempt would succeed. Plan a retry that never charges a card twice.

agreements.title: Retry only a gateway timeout, never a decline
agreements.html: A declined card fails the order at once, as it does today.

sourceRefs.text: The reviewer asked to retry timeouts and leave declines alone.
